issue_context.title: bug: The ...rest props contains $$slots during SSR
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug In runes mode, the `$$slots` is not sanitized by `$props()` in SSR rendering, so it main appear with something like this : ```svelte
    {#each Object.getOwnPropertyNames(rest) as n}
  • {n}
    • {/each}
``` ### Reproduction Look at the page before hydration, the `` component will print "$$slots". It will be removed by the hydration... https://stackblitz.com/edit/svelte5-rest-ssr?file=src%2Froutes%2F%2Bpage.svelte ### Logs _No response_ ### System Info ```shell Lasted Svelte 5 - See stackblitz ``` ### Severity annoyance
